svg.title: 90-day pilot: baseline, shadow mode, validate
svg.desc: Animated timeline. A playhead sweeps across three 30-day phases (baseline, shadow mode, validate and decide), lighting each phase card and turning each decision gate green as it passes.

g.text: 90 days to prove it before scaling
Gate: downtime Pareto vs sensor coverage
No savings claimed from alerts alone
Gate: enough warning, spares and crews?
Re-estimate benefit with real plant inputs
Pass criteria are agreed beforehand and ratified with plant engineering. A stop means re-scoping within Option A.
